This time it will be played on 5 converted CS maps made by [[The_Wizards_Manse|The Wizards Manse]]. The tournament starts February the 26th 2024. 40 players in total. 10 draftpickers/captains will select their teams in a draft into 10 teams. 800 EUR prize pool. == Format == * 2 groups with 5 teams each * Group stage matches are '''Go3''' (Games of 3) * Playoff matches are '''Bo5''' (Best of 5) * All teams 4 games of Go3 and 2-4 games of Bo5 ''(2 teams 2xBo5, 2 teams 4xBo5)'' === Prize pool distribution === {{PrizepoolSE |number=8 |width= |playerwidth=100 |bronzematch=true |symbol= |currency= |symbol2= |currency2= |source= |rate= |date= |p1=Milton's Mutants|f1=eu|m1=€420 |p2=Early Birds|f2=fi|m2=€240 |p3=Bad Boys|f3=pl|m3=€140 |p4=Lionheart Legion|f4=eu|m4=- |p5=Serengeti Tour Guides|f5=eu|m5=-|t5=|c5= |p6=Rats|f6=fi|m6=-|t6=|c6= |p7=CS Lamers|f7=se|m7=-|t7=|c7= |p8=Fun & Lolz|f8=eu|m8=-|t8=|c8= }} == Teams/Draft == [[File:Cs-teams.png|975px|frameless|center]] == Maps == {{Maps |title= |map1=nuke |map2=dust2 |map3=qobblestone |map4=italy |map5=mirage_map }} Download location files [https://gfx.quakeworld.nu/download/605/location-files-for-cs-maps/ HERE]
